name: @aaarnv/sexy-table

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:demo
scripts.build:lib: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build --config vite.library.config.ts && node scripts/build-library.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src *.json vite*.mjs vite*.ts eslint.config.mjs scripts/build-library.mjs README.md docs/plans/2026-10-05-typescript-library-design.md tests/consumer tests/package.test.mjs scripts/verify-consumer.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src *.json vite*.mjs vite*.ts eslint.config.mjs scripts/build-library.mjs README.md docs/plans/2026-10-05-typescript-library-design.md tests/consumer tests/package.test.mjs scripts/verify-consumer.mjs

description: Sexy Table: typed React grouped table with responsive columns and interruptible layout animations.
